$schema_note: Registered second-brain sources. Exactly one source has role=target: this repository itself (path '.'), whose allowlist is the ONLY surface a candidate may mutate. Sources with role=archive are frozen earlier generations kept under brains/<id>/ (see brains/<id>/MIGRATION.json) so their lessons and raw content can be ingested; they are never RSI targets again. `legacy_path` is the original external repository, only ever read. raw/, wiki/, wikis/, credentials, and tool wiring are excluded by the global denylist in src/brain_rsi/sources.py, which no entry can override. `migrate_keep` lists the prefixes of an archive that are carried into brains/<id>/ (scripts/migrate_legacy.py, scripts/prune_archive.py); everything else stays in the archive-of-record and is recorded in MIGRATION.json `not_carried` with its sha256.

sources.description: Generation 4 (template): this repository is the brain. One knowledge base (raw/, wiki/, log/), one agent surface (agent/, .claude/skills/), one RSI harness (eval/, src/, traces/). Legacy generations 1-3 are ingested as raw material + wiki/lessons and then frozen.
notes: CLAUDE.md is the safety contract, not the agent prompt; it is deliberately outside the mutable surface.
wiki/ and raw/ are content (globally denied). wiki/lessons/gen-*.md hold the distilled experience of earlier generations.
eval/ cases should be derived from real operational lessons recorded in wiki/lessons and log/.
Template: replace `remote`, `aliases` and the archive entries below with your own brains; keep the allowlist/denylist shape.
